description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Weatherlight Compleated.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Ugin's Conjurant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, causing you to put a phyresis counter on it and draw a card, thus drawing Omarthis from your library.
Repeat.

uses.name: Weatherlight Compleated
uses.cardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it
